label: Illustrative evidence example
notice: The scores are a synthetic demonstration, not measurements of an actual asset, a validated integrity assessment or an asset retirement obligation accounting number. Both asset views use the same example evidence set.

domains.title: Structural Data
domains.copy: Checks current condition, degradation, modification history and the temporary-state basis behind removal and support decisions.
domains.impact: Removal method, access, lifting, temporary support and sequence.
domains.action: Reconcile structural drawings, inspection evidence and modification records.

domains.title: Hazardous Materials
domains.copy: Tests whether hazardous-material and naturally occurring radioactive material (NORM) registers, surveys and sampling history support packaging and disposal planning.
domains.impact: PPE, decontamination, waste routing, programme and cost.
domains.action: Validate the register against current areas, quantities and classifications.

domains.title: Isolation and Containment
domains.copy: Reviews retained inventories, line status, isolation records and boundary conditions affecting safe preparation.
domains.impact: Make-safe scope, worksite exposure and execution interfaces.
domains.action: Reconcile the isolation philosophy to current P&IDs and field status.

domains.title: As-Built Drawings
domains.copy: Locates modification drift, missing packages and configuration changes that affect the scope basis.
domains.impact: Quantities, access, interfaces and method definition.
domains.action: Prioritise drawings connected to high-consequence scope decisions.

domains.title: Piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs)
domains.copy: Checks revision alignment, tie-ins, process boundaries and whether the process basis reflects the current asset.
domains.impact: Isolation, residual inventory, cleaning and scope limits.
domains.action: Resolve revision conflicts and field-verify critical boundaries.

domains.title: Waste Classification
domains.copy: Reviews expected waste streams, classifications, routing assumptions and current disposal capacity.
domains.impact: Disposal route, logistics, permits, programme and recovery value.
domains.action: Connect material quantities to confirmed classifications and facilities.

domains.title: Well plugging and abandonment (P&A)
domains.copy: Separates well-scope confidence from facility scope and exposes unresolved suspended-well information.
domains.impact: Battery limits, schedule, regulatory pathway and liability allocation.
domains.action: Confirm well status, ownership, records and scope demarcation.

domains.title: Weight Control
domains.copy: Reconciles weight reports, modifications and allowances before lift or transport strategies harden.
domains.impact: Lift studies, transport, support design and contingency.
domains.action: Close the delta between weight reports, drawings and change records.

domains.title: Inspection Records
domains.copy: Connects current condition evidence to access, dismantling and temporary-state assumptions.
domains.impact: Personnel access, plant selection, sequence and risk controls.
domains.action: Confirm the inspection basis remains current for the intended method.

offshore.label: Offshore platform
offshore.domain07Note: Well plugging and abandonment (P&A) is a separate scope. Its applicability depends on the defined asset boundary and current well status.

onshore.label: Onshore plant
onshore.domain07Note: Domain 07 retains the well plugging and abandonment (P&A) category. A well scope applies only where wells form part of the defined asset boundary. This generic plant illustration does not establish that wells are present.

sourceBasis.methodologyAlignment: The current EAI-METH-001 text was not supplied. Domain 07 canonical renaming or remapping requires confirmation against it.
